pets.name: Biscuit
pets.good_with: calm adults, older kids, other mellow dogs
pets.notes: Three-legged after an old injury, fully healed. Shy for the first day, then a velcro dog. Loud howler when left alone more than ~5 hours. House-trained.
pets.status: Listing active; availability changes daily and must be confirmed by the shelter.

pets.name: Luna
pets.not_good_with: being picked up by small children
pets.notes: Independent, likes window perches, litter-trained. Prefers to approach people on her own terms.
pets.status: Listing active; availability changes daily and must be confirmed by the shelter.

pets.name: Rocco
pets.good_with: adults and kids in playgroups, female dogs after slow intro
pets.not_good_with: being alone in a crate all day
pets.notes: Goofy, loves fetch and people. Knows sit/down/paw. Pulls on leash; needs daily exercise (60+ min). Passed shelter temperament assessment.
pets.status: Listing active; availability changes daily and must be confirmed by the shelter.

pets.name: Pepper
pets.notes: Grey muzzle, loves naps and short sniffy walks. On a joint supplement (cost ~$15/month). Long-stay resident: 140 days at the shelter.
pets.status: Listing active; availability changes daily and must be confirmed by the shelter.

messages.text: Hi! I submitted the form for Biscuit last night but wanted to add that we have a fenced yard and I work from home. When could we meet him?
I adopted Pepper's sister Daisy two weeks ago and she's been vomiting since this morning and won't stand up. What do I do??
My landlord says I have to get rid of my 2 cats by Friday or we're evicted. Can you take them? I don't know what else to do.
I'm a retired vet tech and would love to foster seniors or medical cases this winter. How do I sign up?
CONGRATS! Your shelter qualifies for 90% off premium pet supplements. Click bit.ly/xx to claim before midnight!!!
What are your weekend hours, and do adoption fees include microchipping?
We applied for Rocco but honestly I'm not sure my husband is on board and our toddler is scared of big dogs. Should we still come Saturday? Also is the fee refundable?
Found a skinny dog tied outside the gas station on 5th for like 6 hours, no water. Not sure if I should bring it to you or call someone?
Could I foster Luna first to see if she gets along with my dog before I commit to adopting her? She's been limping a bit in her photos, is that ok?
Hey, I can donate 20 bags of dog food and an old crate. Do you guys pick up, or where should I drop it?

profiles.name: The Nguyens
profiles.text: Couple in a 3rd-floor walk-up apartment, no elevator. Both commute; the home is empty about 10 hours on weekdays. No kids, no other pets. First-time pet owners. Like weekend hikes but weekdays are low-key. Building allows dogs under 40 lb and cats.

profiles.name: The Ortiz family
profiles.summary: House + yard · kids 4 & 9 · has a cat
profiles.text: Family with kids aged 4 and 9 in a single-story house with a fenced yard. One parent works from home. They have a 6-year-old cat who is dog-tolerant. Grew up with dogs. Very active: daily park trips, soccer on weekends.

profiles.name: Ruth
profiles.text: Retired teacher living alone in a ground-floor condo with a small patio. Home most of the day. Has had dogs for 40 years; her last dog, a senior terrier, passed last spring. Walks 20-30 minutes twice a day at a slow pace. On a fixed income.

messages: Hi! Biscuit looks adorable. How does he do being home alone?
